fixtures: Files are the user's own notes about a problem or a fix, copied into the run's data/ folder.

evals.name: issue-from-notes
evals.prompt: Turn my notes in data/bug-notes.md into a GitHub issue for the acme-tools maintainers. Don't file it, just give me the title and body.
evals.expected_output: An issue titled in the form [hooks-artifact] <brief description>, e.g. [hooks-artifact] PostToolUse format hook never fires in Cursor. The body has Artifact (the format-on-edit hook, a hook, Cursor), Source (github.com/acme/acme-tools, hooks/hooks.json, v1.4.0), Expected behavior, Actual behavior, Reproduction (the steps from the notes, with Cursor 1.9.2), and Impact (red CI builds for Cursor users). It also carries the optional details the notes give: Cursor and Claude Code versions and that it is consistent.
assertions: The body has separate parts for Artifact, Source, Expected behavior, Actual behavior, Reproduction and Impact
Source names github.com/acme/acme-tools, hooks/hooks.json and v1.4.0
Reproduction gives the steps from the notes (install v1.4.0 in Cursor, ask the agent to edit a .ts file, check formatting)
Includes Cursor 1.9.2 as the vendor version
Says the behavior is consistent, not intermittent
Impact mentions the failing CI builds for Cursor users

evals.name: vague-report
evals.prompt: the deploy skill from our plugin does nothing in copilot cli. write up an issue for it
evals.expected_output: Does not produce a finished issue: source, expected and actual behavior, reproduction and impact are all unknown. Asks the user one question to fill the first missing field, and waits.
assertions: Does not present a finished issue whose fields are unknown, TBD or invented
Asks the user a question about a missing field (such as the plugin's repo, what deploy should do, or how to reproduce)
Asks one question, not a list of several questions at once

evals.name: notes-missing-source
evals.prompt: Turn my notes in data/bug-notes-no-source.md into a GitHub issue I can file.
evals.expected_output: The notes give the artifact (the lint-fix skill), expected and actual behavior, versions, reproduction and impact, but not the source: which plugin, repo and version the skill comes from. That is a required field, and without it the issue cannot go to the right maintainer, so the reply does not compose a finished issue with the source left blank, TBD or guessed. It asks one question, for the source (which plugin or repo, and version), and does not re-ask anything the notes already give.
assertions: Identifies the source (which plugin or repo the skill comes from, and its version) as the missing field
Does not present a finished issue with the source left blank, TBD, unknown or guessed
Asks one question, about the source, without listing further questions
Does not ask about anything the notes already give (versions, what happens, how to reproduce, impact)
